about.title: About Alpha 0.4
about.included.b: One full single-player season: pick a club, set your lineup, set each player's training, draft heroes against the clock, set your game plan, watch the match feed, read the report. 10 clubs, 18 league rounds, then a top-4 playoff (semi-finals best of 3, final best of 5). Players grow with training and tire from playing; veterans decline over the years. You also run the money: sign free agents, renew or release players, choose a sponsor, and stay out of debt. Your players also bond: starters who play together build Team chemistry (a small rating bonus), and every player has Form and Morale that follow results and playing time. Your progress saves automatically.
about.test.b: New in this build: Team chemistry (club office), Form and Morale, and the Team scrim training option. Do you understand why a player is 'in form' or 'unhappy'? Does it feel right that changing a starter costs a little chemistry? Is a game still quick (about 5 minutes with the draft)? Anything confusing, slow or broken?
about.limits.b: Transfers between clubs and youth intake. The live match arena comes in Alpha 0.8. Hero and player names are placeholders.
about.report.b: Open Settings and tap Copy debug info, then paste it into your message with what you saw. Screenshots help too.

stat.help.mec: Mechanics: how fast and precisely he executes. Matters most for carries and mid.
stat.help.sen: Game Sense: awareness and decision quality. Matters most for supports and the jungle.
stat.help.lan: Laning: early trading and wave control. Decides who leads after the first minutes.

gl.title: Glossary
gl.team_rating.name: Team rating
gl.team_rating.def: The average skill of your five starters in the roles they play. It leaves out form, tiredness and heroes.
gl.rating.name: Rating
gl.rating.def: A player's skill in one role, built from their stats. Playing out of position lowers it.
gl.role.name: Role
gl.role.def: A player's job on the team: Top, Jungle, Mid, Bot Carry or Support.
gl.stats.name: Stats
gl.stats.def: The eight skills that make up a rating. Tap a stat on a player card to read what it does.
gl.potential.name: Potential
gl.potential.def: The most a player can grow to in a stat. Young players with high potential become stars but ask for more money.
gl.form.name: Form
gl.form.def: How well a player has done lately. Results move it, and it fades over the days. A player in form plays better.
gl.morale.name: Morale
gl.morale.def: How happy a player is. Results and playing time raise it. A starter who sits out for a while gets unhappy.
gl.fatigue.name: Fatigue
gl.fatigue.def: Tiredness from playing. Tired starters lose rating, shown as worn, tired or exhausted.
gl.bonds.name: Bonds
gl.bonds.def: How well two players know each other. They grow when the pair plays together. A new teammate starts low.
gl.understanding.name: Understanding
gl.understanding.def: How clearly one player takes in what a teammate says. Bond, Communication and a shared language all help.
gl.chemistry.name: Chemistry
gl.chemistry.def: Your five starters' bonds and understanding, turned into a small rating bonus for the whole team.
gl.personality.name: Personality
gl.personality.def: How a player behaves in talks: Professional, Balanced, Casual or Temperamental.
gl.training_focus.name: Training focus
gl.training_focus.def: What a player works on between match days: one stat, a hero, a team scrim or rest.
gl.rest.name: Rest
gl.rest.def: A training choice that adds no tiredness and clears some. Use it for a worn starter.
gl.scrim.name: Team scrim
gl.scrim.def: A practice week that builds bonds a little faster. It adds no stat growth.
gl.coach.name: Coach
gl.coach.def: Your club's helper. It suggests bans, picks, game plans and training. You always decide.
gl.draft.name: Draft
gl.draft.def: Before each game both teams take turns to ban and pick heroes. If the timer runs out, the Coach chooses.
gl.ban.name: Ban
gl.ban.def: Removing a hero so neither team can use it. Ban the heroes their players know best.
gl.pick.name: Pick
gl.pick.def: Choosing a hero for one of your players. Each hero plays one role.
gl.hero.name: Hero
gl.hero.def: The character a player controls. Each has a style, strengths and a role it suits.
gl.familiarity.name: Familiarity
gl.familiarity.def: How well a player knows a hero. Higher means better play. It grows a little after each real game.
gl.fit.name: Fit
gl.fit.def: How well a hero suits the role it is given. 100 percent is perfect and less costs rating.
gl.patch_strength.name: Patch strength
gl.patch_strength.def: How strong a hero is in the current patch. Strong heroes are the better choice.
gl.patch.name: Patch
gl.patch.def: A balance update that changes which heroes are strong. Home shows the current one, like P1.
gl.composition.name: Composition
gl.composition.def: How your five heroes work together. It has a style, such as Dive or Siege, and gives a bonus or a penalty.
gl.game_plan.name: Game plan
gl.game_plan.def: Your instructions for how the team plays: fights, tempo, objectives, lanes, support and risk. You set it after the draft.
gl.edge.name: Expected edge
gl.edge.def: Your advantage before luck, from ratings, heroes and plan. Luck can still change a single game.
gl.risk.name: Risk
gl.risk.def: How swingy you want the game. More risk helps the underdog and hurts the favourite.
gl.lane.name: Lane
gl.lane.def: One of the three paths between the bases: Top, Mid and Bot. The Jungle is the space between them.
gl.objective.name: Objective
gl.objective.def: A big neutral target in the middle or late game. Winning it gives your team a lead.
gl.teamfight.name: Teamfight
gl.teamfight.def: A fight with all five players. The mid and late fights often decide the game.
gl.base.name: Base
gl.base.def: The main building. The team that destroys the enemy base wins the game.
gl.margin.name: Margin
gl.margin.def: How big a result was: narrow, clear or decisive.
gl.standout.name: Standout
gl.standout.def: The player whose role moved the result most for your team.
gl.luck.name: Luck
gl.luck.def: The random part of every game that no plan or draft controls. The report shows how much it moved the result.
gl.table.name: League table
gl.table.def: Clubs ranked by points. A win is worth 3. Ties go to head-to-head wins, then total margin.
gl.form_rating.name: Form Rating
gl.form_rating.def: A running skill score for every club. Beating strong clubs in big games lifts it most. Practice games never count.
gl.playoffs.name: Playoffs
gl.playoffs.def: After the league rounds, the best clubs play short series for the title.
gl.best_of.name: Best of
gl.best_of.def: A series won by the first side to take most of the games. Best of 3 needs two wins.
gl.practice_match.name: Practice match
gl.practice_match.def: A game that never counts for the table, Form Rating, form, morale or sponsor goals.
gl.quick_match.name: Quick Match
gl.quick_match.def: One practice game against a club close to your strength.
gl.exhibition.name: Exhibition
gl.exhibition.def: A practice series against any club you choose: best of 1, 3 or 5.
gl.contract.name: Contract
gl.contract.def: A player's deal: a weekly wage and a number of seasons. When it ends, the player leaves unless you renew.
gl.wage.name: Wage
gl.wage.def: What a player is paid each week. Wages are paid every round.
gl.wage_cap.name: Wage cap
gl.wage_cap.def: The most you can pay players each week. A signing that goes over it is blocked.
gl.cash.name: Cash
gl.cash.def: Your club's money. If it stays below zero too long, the board dismisses you.
gl.sponsor.name: Sponsor
gl.sponsor.def: A partner that pays a weekly retainer and a bonus for hitting a target such as wins or a playoff place.
gl.free_agent.name: Free agent
gl.free_agent.def: A player with no club. You can sign them if you have cash, squad room and room under the wage cap.
gl.signing_fee.name: Signing fee
gl.signing_fee.def: A one-off payment to sign a player: two weeks of their wage.
gp.trigger_late_only: Only the part from the mid-game on applies in this plan.
gp.coach.none: No changes needed. Your plan already suits this matchup.
help.home.title: Home
help.home.see: Your next match day, how you compare with the other club, and four summary tiles.
help.home.do: Tap Play game to start. Tap a tile to open that part of your club.
help.home.know: "Needs your attention" lists things to fix before you play, like tired starters.
help.squad.title: Squad
help.squad.see: Your five starters on a small map, one per role, and the bench below.
help.squad.do: Tap a starter to change who plays that role. Tap a bench player to open their card.
help.squad.know: A player out of position loses rating. Pick best lineup for me fixes it in one tap.
help.player.title: Player card
help.player.see: Tiredness, form and morale bars, the contract, bonds and best heroes. Stats and Career are one tap away.
help.player.do: Tap Stats to read what each stat does. Renew a contract that is ending.
help.player.know: Potential is the most a stat can grow to. Young players grow fastest.
help.plan.title: Plan
help.plan.see: Training, team chemistry, practice matches and your game plan status.
help.plan.do: Tap a tile to open it. Check training before every match day.
help.plan.know: You set the game plan during each draft, after the picks, because it depends on the heroes.
help.training.title: Training
help.training.see: What every player works on until the next match day, and how tired your starters will be.
help.training.do: Tap a player to pick a stat, a hero, a team scrim or rest.
help.training.know: Training adds a little tiredness. Resting adds none and clears some.
help.chemistry.title: Team chemistry
help.chemistry.see: The bonds between your five starters, who understands whom, languages and the bench.
help.chemistry.do: Look for weak pairs. Use team scrims in Training to build bonds.
help.chemistry.know: Swapping a starter costs chemistry until the new pairs have played together.
help.practice.title: Practice matches
help.practice.see: Quick Match and Exhibition. They never count for the table or Form Rating.
help.practice.do: Play a Quick Match for a fast game. Choose Exhibition for a club and a series length.
help.practice.know: One practice series per match day. Starters get a little tired and bond a little.
help.prematch.title: Match day
help.prematch.see: Your club against theirs, role by role, with each player's rating in that role.
help.prematch.do: Check the rows, rest tired starters if offered, then tap Start draft.
help.prematch.know: Tired starters play below their rating. "Auto-play this game" skips the watching.
help.draft.title: Draft
help.draft.see: Whose turn it is, you on the left and them on the right, and the heroes you can choose.
help.draft.do: Ban heroes their players know best. Pick heroes your players know and that fit the role.
help.draft.know: If the timer runs out the Coach chooses for you. Auto-finish hands the draft to the Coach.
help.gameplan.title: Game plan
help.gameplan.see: Your expected edge on top, then settings for each phase: fights, tempo, objectives, lanes, support and risk.
help.gameplan.do: Tap a stop on a track to change it. Tap Coach to see a suggested plan.
help.gameplan.know: Edge is before luck. Risk helps the underdog and hurts the favourite. Your plan is kept for the next game.
help.match.title: Match
help.match.see: The clock, kills, towers and who is ahead, with each result shown as it is decided.
help.match.do: Watch, tap Speed x2 to go faster, or Skip to the end.
help.match.know: The result was decided before you watched, so watching or skipping never changes it.
help.report.title: Match report
help.report.see: The result, the standout player, what the game changed, one tip, and why it went this way.
help.report.do: Tap the big number to see why this happened. Tap Continue when done.
help.report.know: Luck is a factor. A big luck share means the game could have gone either way.
help.club.title: Club
help.club.see: Money, the league table, Form Rating and free agents, each with one line of status.
help.club.do: Tap a tile to open it.
help.club.know: If cash stays below zero too long, the board dismisses you.
help.standings.title: Standings
help.standings.see: The league table with a podium, the playoff bracket, and your history of games and trophies.
help.standings.do: Tap Table, Playoffs or History. Tap Points or Form Rating to change the ranking. Your club says YOU.
help.standings.know: A win is worth 3 points. Ties go to head-to-head wins, then total margin.
help.finance.title: Finance
help.finance.see: Your cash, weekly income and wages, the sponsor and every payment.
help.finance.do: Pick a sponsor before your first game of the season. Watch the wage cap.
help.finance.know: Wages are paid every round. Over the cap, signings are blocked.
help.freeagents.title: Free agents
help.freeagents.see: Players with no club, with rating, potential and the wage they ask.
help.freeagents.do: Filter by role, sort by what matters, tap a player to talk.
help.freeagents.know: Your squad has a limit. A signing needs cash for the fee and room under the wage cap.
help.negotiation.title: Contract talks
help.negotiation.see: The player, what a deal does to your wages, cap and cash, and your offers left.
help.negotiation.do: Set the wage and length, then tap Make offer.
help.negotiation.know: What a player will accept is secret. A temperamental player walks away after two refusals.
help.season.title: Season summary
help.season.see: How the season ended, your history, who grew, and contracts that end now.
help.season.do: Renew players you want to keep before starting the next season.
help.season.know: A player with an ended contract leaves when the new season starts.
help.settings.title: Settings
help.settings.see: Quick mode, animations, comfort options, help and learning, feedback and the save.
help.settings.do: Try the Comfort options, such as larger text. Replay the tutorial any time.
help.settings.know: Your game is saved only on this device.
help.clubselect.title: Choose your club
help.clubselect.see: Every club with its team rating, strength tier and rank.
help.clubselect.do: Pick the club you will manage. The middle of the table is a fair first choice.
help.clubselect.know: Starting a new game later lets you try another club.
les.l1.open: Tap Standing to open the league table.
les.l1.table: A win is worth 3 points. The top four clubs reach the playoffs. Ties go to head-to-head wins, then total margin.
les.l1.metric: Switch between Points and Form Rating. Your club is marked YOU in both.
les.l1.tabs: Playoffs shows the title series as a bracket. History keeps your recent games and your trophies.
les.l2.open: Players grow a little between match days. Tap Training to choose what each one works on.
les.l2.preview: These chips show how many starters are tired now, and after the next game. Tired starters lose rating.
les.l2.player: Tap a player to choose a focus: a stat, a hero, a team scrim or rest.
les.l2.rest: Rest adds no tiredness and clears some. Pick it for a worn starter. Changes apply at once, and you can Undo.
les.l3.open: Contracts last a set number of seasons. Tap Squad to see who is close to the end.
les.l3.row: Tap a bench player whose contract is ending.
les.l3.contract: The card shows the weekly wage and the seasons left. When none are left, the player leaves unless you renew.
les.l3.renew: Renew starts talks. Young players with high potential ask for more, and the wage cap limits what you can afford.
les.l4.open: Bonds grow when players play together. Tap Team chemistry to see yours.
les.l4.summary: Chemistry turns the bonds of your five starters into a small rating bonus for the whole team.
les.l4.map: Each line is a bond between two starters. Thicker lines mean stronger bonds.
les.l4.scrim: Team scrims in Training build bonds a little faster. Swapping a starter costs chemistry until the new pairs have played.
les.l5.open: Tap Game plan to look at your options.
les.l5.edge: Expected edge is your advantage before luck. Your plan moves it. Luck can still change a single game.
les.l5.contests: Each row is one contest: a lane, the jungle, an objective or a fight. Plus means you are stronger there, minus means they are.
les.l5.phases: Overall, Early, Mid and Late are the phases of a game. Tap one to see its settings and where you stand.
les.l5.plan: Plan: Default is used from the start. If behind or If ahead can take over from the mid-game, after a one-sided early game.
les.l5.sliders: Each setting trades one strength for another. Risk and aggression make games swingier, which helps the underdog.
les.l6.club: Tap Club to find your money.
les.l6.finance: Tap Finance to see where your cash goes.
les.l6.balance: Balance is your cash. Wages are paid every round. If it stays below zero too long, the board dismisses you.
les.l6.cap: The wage cap is the most you can pay players each week. Signings over the cap are blocked.
les.l6.sponsor: A sponsor pays a weekly retainer and a bonus for hitting its target. You can change it until your first game.
les.l6.sponsor_locked: A sponsor pays a weekly retainer and a bonus for hitting its target. This season's deal is fixed.
les.l7.open: Free agents have no club. Young players with high potential grow into stars but ask for more. Tap Free agents.
les.l7.filters: Filter by role and sort by rating, potential, age or price.
les.l7.row: Tap a player to start talks. What they will accept is a secret, so make an offer and read the reply.
les.l8.payoff: This card shows what the game did to form, morale, bonds and cash. Form and morale change how players perform next time.
les.l8.tip: The tip points at the most useful thing to fix before your next game.
lessons.title: Lessons
report.story.ppm: Ahead, then lost the late game
report.story.pmp: Ahead early and late, behind mid-game
report.story.mpp: Slow start, then you took over
report.story.mpm: Behind early, ahead only in the middle
report.hero.help: {what} helped most. It decided {pct}% of the result.
report.hero.hurt: {what} cost you most. It decided {pct}% of the result.
report.hero.luck_for: Luck helped you. {pct}% of this result was luck, the random part of every game.
report.hero.luck_against: Luck was against you. {pct}% of this result was luck, the random part of every game.
report.luck_note: Luck is the random part of every game, the part no plan or draft controls.
settings.replay_confirm: Replay the guided first game? It is a practice game. Nothing in your save changes.
squad.swap_note: {name} already starts, so you two will swap roles.
standings.cut.in: Top 4 go through. You are #{rank}, {n} pts clear of 5th.
standings.cut.on: Top 4 go through. You are #{rank}, level on points with the line.
standings.cut.out: Top 4 go through. You are #{rank}, {n} pts behind the line.
standings.cut.after: The league rounds are over. The top 4 are in the playoffs.
tut.welcome: Welcome, Manager. You run {club}. Let's play one practice game together. It takes a few minutes, and nothing in it counts.
tut.home_card: This is your next match day: who you play and how you compare. Home always shows what to do next.
tut.tabs: Five tabs hold your club: Home, Squad, Plan, Club and More. They are always here, so you cannot get lost.
tut.tab_squad: Squad is where you see your players. Tap Squad.
tut.squad_bench: Your five starters stand on the map and play every game. Tap a bench player to open their card.
tut.player_card: This is a player card. The bars show tiredness, form and morale. Tired or unhappy players play worse.
tut.tab_plan: Plan is where you prepare between games: training, team chemistry and practice. Tap Plan.
tut.plan_practice: Practice games never count: not the table, not Form Rating, not morale. A safe place to learn. Tap Practice matches.
tut.quick_match: A Quick Match is one game against a club close to your strength. Tap Play a Quick Match.
tut.matchups: Each row compares your player with theirs in that role. Higher numbers are better. Look for roles where you are ahead.
tut.start_draft: Next is the draft, where both teams ban and pick heroes. Tap Start draft.
tut.ban: First, a ban. Banning a hero stops the other team using it. Tap any hero, then Ban, or tap Take on the Coach bar.
tut.pick: Now pick a hero for your team. Heroes with an up arrow are strong this patch. Tap a hero, or tap Take.
tut.role: Choose which role plays this hero. The percentage is how well it fits that role. The best fit is already chosen. Tap Pick.
tut.coach_rest: You can pick every hero yourself, or let the Coach finish the draft. Tap Auto-finish, then tap Sure? to confirm.
tut.open_plan: Draft done. Next, a game plan tells your team how to play: fights, tempo, objectives. Tap Game plan.
tut.coach_suggest: Not sure what to set? Tap Coach. It suggests a plan from how your team compares with theirs.
tut.start_match: Happy with the plan? Tap Start the match to watch the game.
tut.watch: Results appear in the feed as each part of the game is decided. Try Speed x2, or Skip to the end.
tut.see_report: The game is over. Tap See the report.
tut.result.win: Victory. The report starts with the result and the margin. This was practice, so nothing changed in your season.
tut.result.loss: Defeat. That is fine. It was practice, and nothing changed in your season. The report shows why it went this way.
tut.why: This number is the biggest factor in the result. Tap it to see every factor. Luck is one of them.
tut.continue: Tap Continue to leave the report. After real games it also shows what changed for your players.
tut.tab_club: Club holds money, the league table and Form Rating. Tap Club.
tut.form_tile: Form Rating is a skill score for every club. Beating strong clubs raises it. Practice games never count. Tap it.
tut.form_switch: This list ranks clubs by Form Rating. Tap Points to switch to league points. Your club is marked YOU in both.
tut.finish: You are ready. Go to Home and tap Play game for your first real match. The ? button explains any screen.
tut.coach_rest.sure: Tap Sure? to let the Coach finish.
tut.coach_suggest.apply: These are the changes. Tap Apply to use them.
tut.why.sheet: Each bar is how much one factor moved the result. Luck is the random part of every game.
tut.watch.arena: Your team is the circles. Watch the fight, or use Speed x2 or Skip to the end.
tut.squad_bench.alt: Your five starters play every game. Tap a bench player to open their card.
tut.squad_token: Your five starters stand on the map. Tap one to see who else could play that role.
tut.picker: Each row shows the change to team rating if you pick that player. We will not change anything now.
tut.nudge: Tap the highlighted spot to continue.
tut.skipped_toast: Tutorial skipped. You can replay it in Settings.
tut.left: Leaving the tutorial here. You can replay it in Settings.
tut.back.body: Your game is safe. You can replay the tutorial any time in Settings.
tut.resume: Welcome back. Continue the guided first game?
tut.offer.legacy: New: a guided first game and help on every screen.
tut.offer.returning: Welcome back, Manager. Want the guided first game again?
tut.fallback: We cannot find that on this screen. Tap Next to continue.
tut.report_card.body: Nothing in your season changed. This game was only for learning.
tut.practice.note: Tutorial match: nothing in it counts.
tut.draft.note: No timer in the tutorial. Take your time.
